block-guide:
CORE/ICON (new in WordPress 7.0) One SVG icon from WordPress's icon library, drawn by the server. The block stores the icon's NAME, never SVG: an
. ICON NAMES ("collection/name"; plugins may add collections) core/ + a name from the library (88 icons), for example: arrow-up, arrow-down, arrow-left, arrow-right, arrow-up-left, arrow-up-right, arrow-down-left, arrow-down-right, chevron-up, chevron-down, chevron-left, chevron-right (each also -small), chevron-up-down, check, plus, plus-circle, search, menu, more-horizontal, more-vertical, home, envelope, at-symbol, map-marker, calendar, scheduled, bell, cart, store, payment, receipt, download, upload, external, share, rss, comment, quote, people, key, shield, settings, info, help, tip, caution, error, star-empty, star-half, star-filled, image, gallery, audio, capture-photo, capture-video, desktop, tablet, mobile, language, tag, category, file, pencil, published, next, previous, shuffle, chart-bar, table. An unknown name renders nothing, with no error. OPTIONS textColor / style.color.text: the icon's colour (it is drawn in currentColor). style.dimensions.width: the size (the icon is square). align: "left" | "center" | "right". rotation: 0, 90, 180 or 270 (the editor's steps). flipHorizontal / flipVertical: true mirrors. ariaLabel: a meaningful icon gets role="img" and this label; without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). Give a label when the icon carries meaning on its own. CHECK Open the page: the icon appears at the chosen size and colour; reopen the editor.
